profile_text.body:
Zhipu AI is a Chinese artificial intelligence company whose stated mission is inspiring artificial general intelligence to benefit humanity. The company develops foundation models and related applications, operating under the brand Z.AI. Its publicly described products include AutoClaw (澳龙), described as the first domestically available one-click local OpenClaw client, which bundles more than 50 built-in skills and integrates AutoGLM browser operation capabilities. The company also develops Zhipu Qingyan, an on-device assistant, and CodeGeeX, an AI-powered programming assistant, both of which have been released in AI PC editions.

The company describes itself as an important partner of Intel, and its vice president Wu Weijie appeared at Intel's AI PC Ecosystem Conference to present joint results from collaboration between the two companies in the AI PC sector. That partnership is described as spanning on-device and cloud-integrated model products, with several AI PC application outcomes attributed to the collaboration.

The site's held facts list Zhipu AI's primary tracked product as GLM / Z.AI, categorized under Chinese foundation models, with a noted advisory that cross-border data review is recommended for users of that product. No litigation, SEC filings, MCP server registrations, or patent records appear in the available data.
